post.title: By our math, a $1,200 phone costs about 47 hours of work
post.ig:
By our math, a $1,200 phone costs about 47 hours of work at average pay.
BLS: average private-sector pay was $38.00 an hour in October 2026 ($25.64 yearly average in 2016, $36.45 in 2025).
Our math: $1,200 / $38 = 31.6 hours. Assume 25% goes to taxes (illustrative, not anyone's real rate) and it's 42.1 hours.
Add the average 26.4-minute commute each way (Census, 2020-2024) to an 8-hour day and the real wage is $25.68, so 46.7 hours.
The real hourly wage idea comes from Vicki Robin and Joe Dominguez's 1992 book Your Money or Your Life.
Sources: BLS, US Census Bureau, Your Money or Your Life.
